name: build-helper
description: Build and test helper for wallpaper-play. Use when Codex needs to run local macOS app build or XCTest from terminal with xcodebuild and format logs via xcbeautify.
author: nhiroyasu
readme: # Wallpaper Play ![icon](previews/icon.png) The wallpaper engine for macOS. # App Store # Feature This app allows you to set videos as macOS wallpaper. ## Contents that can be set as wallpaper - local video ( .mp4, .mov etc...) - youtube - website - camera ## Previews ### Video ![video-preview](previews/localvideo-preview.gif) ### YouTube ![video-preview](previews/youtube-preview.gif) ### Website ![video-preview](previews/webpage-preview.gif)
